text: If you ever feel invisible, remember I notice everything about you.
You're a good person. Never let a bad day tell you otherwise.
Tomorrow is a new page and I'll be on it with you.
You make me want to be kinder.
There's nobody else I'd rather argue with and make up with.
If today is hard, I'll be here tomorrow too, and the day after that.
I'm a better person because I know you.
You deserve the kind of love that feels like a warm hug.
Every time I see a full moon I wonder if you're looking at it too.
Can we stay friends until we're ninety?
You are the first person I want to tell good news to.
When I think of being happy, I think of us laughing for no reason.
You're more than your bad days. You're my best days.
Missing you is just the price of having someone this nice to miss.
Sorry i don't wanna be mean but, You're sweeter than anything on your plate today.
There's a saying that the time you spend on someone is what makes them important. We've spent a lot, so you're very important.
One day we'll sit somewhere with coffee and talk for hours with no phone in hand.
I hope your mornings feel refreshing.
My favourite season is wherever you are.
You're stronger than you think, but you don't have to prove it.
When life gets loud, come to me. I'll keep it quiet for you.
I'm not good with words, so I'll just say thank you for being you.
Bad days don't last, but people like you do.
Sorry in advance for every time I'm annoying. I just love talking to you.
The best part of my day is when you say "manjiii".
Be your own kind of person. I like that kind best.
When two people care about each other, no distance is too long.
I want to hear about your day, even the small boring parts.
If I get one wish today, I'll use it to make your day easier.
You're somebody's whole good day. Mine.
I'm so lucky our paths crossed.
You are enough on your lowest day and on your highest day.
I'll cheer for you even when you think nobody's watching.
Whatever you become, I'll be the loudest one clapping.
I like the person I am when I'm talking to you.
No body tolerates me like you do.
Even on my busiest day, there's always a little room in my head for you.
If I could give you anything, I'd give you the ability to see yourself the way I see you.
Whenever it rains, I picture you looking out of your window.
Bad days end. I'll stay until yours does.
YOU MATTER A LOT TO ME. Just wanted to say it out loud.
If I had to be born as a drink, I'd be your iced vanilla coffee so you'd pick me every time.
You're my favourite person to say "guess what" to.
My moonbeam, even a bad day looks softer with your name on my screen. I love your name.
It's okay to be a work in progress. So am I.
I still smile at things you said years ago.
Take a deep breath. Now another one. Good job, I'm proud.
You're my safe place. I hope I'm yours.
Thank you for being patient with me when I'm being a bhondu.
Wherever you go, I hope there's good weather and better people.
You're the reason I believe good people still exist.
Keep going forward!
Be gentle with yourself, the way you are with everyone else.
If the moon is out tonight, look at it. I'll be looking too.
Let's keep making memories.
It's okay if you bloom late. Tulips take their time and look how pretty they are.
Sometimes I just want to say your name for no reason. Wajeeha. See?
I think about meeting you more than I tell you.
There's no one I'd rather be silly with.
I don't know how to say it better, so: I really care about you.
It's alright to start over as many times as you want.
If you were a dessert, you'd be the last bite I save for myself.
Everything feels like it's going to be okay when you're around.
You're the kind of person I wish I'd met sooner.
Have a sweet day, you sweet person.
Whoever hurt you didn't know your worth. I do.
You're my "everything will be okay" in human form.
You're allowed to take up space in this world, and in my heart too.
My heart does a small happy dance when you text me.
Happiness looks good on you. I hope you wear it more often.
Have I told you today that you're pretty? You are.
I hope someone gives you flowers today, and if nobody does, imagine I did.
Philosophers spent their whole lives asking what the meaning of life is. I think it's good people and good food.
You're made of stardust and sugar, in my opinion.
I want to be there for the boring days too, not only the big ones.
Home is wherever you feel safe. I hope I'm one of those places for you.
You have so much love to give and I hope the right people receive it.
I read somewhere that the best thing to hold in a storm is each other. Hold on to me.
If I got a tulip every time I thought of you, My city name will become tulipgarh
And it goes away when i talk to you
Drink some water, sweetheart. I'll wait.
Not everything needs a reason. I just like talking to you.
Whenever you feel low, remember I look forward to your messages.
Forever is a big word, but I like using it with you.
I'm going to be annoying about this: you deserve good things.
My day feels incomplete without a message from you.
One day I'll finally hug you and you'll have to tolerate it.
When I have a bad day I think of you and it gets less bad.
Even the moon takes breaks. You can too.
You make my world a little less lonely.
If I ever get rich, the first thing I'm buying is a huge box of all your favourite sweets.
If I could keep one thing forever, it would be your drawings (i have them all bwahah)
I'd tell you "you're doing great" every hour if I could. Cause you really are.
You're my favourite person to be stubborn with.
Honestly, you're the best thing that happened to me this life.
You don't have to be perfect for me. You're already my favourite. (is that what makes you so perfect!)
I hope something makes you smile for no reason today.
You can lean on me. I'm sturdier than I look.
Look at the sky today. It's showing off for you.
Some people feel like home. You're the one.
You are not too much for me. You never were.
I'd share my last gummy bear with you. Maybe the second last, let me think about it.
I get a little happy every time I see you typing.
Little reminder that someone far away thinks about you every single day. (*minute)
Whatever happens, you still have me. That part doesn't expire.
Your heart is soft and I hope the world is careful with it.
When you're sad I'm sad too, so please be happy for my sake.
Im waiting...
I like that you care about little things. They're the big things.
You're the kind of person people write letters for.
If love is a garden, you're the tulip I'd water every day.
You are my favourite notification, sweetheart.
You can say no. You can say not now. You can say I'm tired. I'll understand every time.
You've survived every bad day so far. That's a perfect record.
New rule: nobody is allowed to make you cry, including me. I'm working on it.
They say home isn't a place, it's a feeling. You feel like that to me.
I believe in you even when you don't.
You have a heart that deserves a pretty life.
Meeting you was the best gift life gave me without it being my birthday.
Somewhere there's a day where I'm sitting next to you with a bowl of rass malayi. I'm working on getting there.
You make normal days feel like something I want to remember.
Do something nice for yourself today, even something tiny.
I love you. Just saying, in case you forgot.
Let's get so old that we forget each other's names and still text every morning.
You never have to earn my love. It's already yours.
Take your time. Nobody is racing you.
You look good in whatever you wear. That's just a fact.
Every beautiful thing in my day reminds me of you.
Don't stay up too late. I need you well rested so you can annoy me tomorrow. (its a request)
Your voice is something I'd pay money to hear.
I'm proud of you for getting up again today. That counts for a lot.
I'd pick you for my team in every game, even the ones you're bad at.
If you ever doubt yourself, ask me. I have a long list.
I think you're really brave.
Hey you, yes you, I like you a lot.
Eat first, worry later. This is a rule I just made.
You have a beautiful mind. Use it to dream big.
I'd give you my umbrella and happily get wet myself.
If you read this far, I love you. If you skipped to the end, I still love you.
